paragraphs: The pages describe SOVRA as a procurement platform for public agencies, spanning intake, solicitation authoring, proposal management, evaluation and contract creation. On the government buyer page, the same platform is described as covering procurement from intake through contract management, with a supplier network of more than 1 million suppliers. That page also lists three core areas, procurement management, spend optimization and supplier network, and says the platform is fully modular.

A second set of products is sold to suppliers, helping them discover relevant solicitations from thousands of public agencies across North America. Products named for that side include Bidnet Direct, Merx and Ontopical, which the supplier page ties to active bids and to earlier planning signals. The supplier page offers matching with opportunities from more than 90,000 government agencies.

On the government buyer page, the answer to who the platform serves names state and local governments, school districts and higher education. The same page says the platform supports more than 7,000 government agencies.

quote.text: Public procurement works best when buyers and suppliers operate in the same network. SOVRA powers both sides.
